agent_id.description: the agent's id: its entry `entity:<id>` in the colony's affinity, stamped on every `affinity_propose` so the embedder's edge names the actor `agent:<id>`

start_memories.description: `{what, with?, at?}` written once as episodes

own_tools.description: the agent's own tool names: a client tool of the same name is dropped

round_idle_ms.description: the round watchdog's wait; keep it equal to the collector's

client_tool_timeout_ms.description: how long a client call may stay unanswered; then its result is `error: timeout: ...` and the round goes on

store_read_ms.description: how long a child life waits for `./door_store` to answer its read before it asks again

strong.description: the second brain's model or registry subscription; empty = off, every turn runs fast

tools_allow.description: the tool scope of every turn (an allow list also filters client tools)

tools_deny.description: tools removed from every turn's scope

now_utc.description: an ISO instant the watchdog reads instead of the wall clock (tests)
